annotations.title: Historical UFO cases near a place

description: List historical UFO/UAP reports from the Hatch UDB archive (1900-2002, compiled by Larry Hatch) near a point, optionally filtered by country or text. Use it for the history of a region; it is not a live feed of recent sightings (use sky_events) and geocoding is approximate. Read-only query of the Vigi-Sky API; default radius 50 km, 200 km when filtering by country or text.

country.description: Optional country filter as written in the archive, e.g. FRANCE, USA.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

q.description: Optional text filter on the case summary, e.g. 'cigar' or 'Valensole'.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (default 50, or 200 with country/q; maximum 20000).

name: nearby_cases

outputSchema.description: Returns archive, query, returned, cases [...], not_vigisky_live (always true).

title: Historical UFO cases near a place
